description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/latlon_advection_meridional_zero_grad.esm (model MeridionalAdvection, test mms_steady_polar_cap) at the problem's default resolution (NLAT=91, NLON edge-bound to 8) through each binding's official simulation pathway. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

python._doc: Pinned to match the cartesian problems' convention: LSODA at 1e-12/1e-14 keeps Python temporal truncation negligible against the spatial goldens (the centered-advection system is non-stiff but neutrally stable, where loose explicit tolerances would add spurious dissipation).
